name: hermit-manifest-namespace-collision-auditing
instr:
Hermit cannot currently audit definition namespaces for precedence, collisions, source availability, and policy outcomes without reading bodies or contacting remotes. Build a deterministic, credential-safe audit and let environments reject ambiguous definitions.

BuiltInSource, LocalSource, MemSource, and GitSource must inventory their storage in normalized lexical name order without parsing bodies. Reject malformed, nested, or non-HCL names with InventoryError before analysis. Preserve redacted source identities and each source's availability semantics. BuiltInSource inventories every embedded top-level definition, reports unreadable storage, and stays first under permissive resolution. LocalSource retains each original URI. MemSource reports exactly its logical name, omits unsafe names, and inventories safe names despite malformed contents. GitSource distinguishes a missing checkout from an empty repository and never exposes authenticated credentials. A failed refresh keeps an existing usable checkout for inventory, audit, and resolution.

In github.com/cashapp/hermit/sources, define ManifestEntry fields Name and SourceURI; SourceInventory fields URI, Entries, and Available; and InventoryError fields SourceURI, Entry, and Err. In github.com/cashapp/hermit/manifest, AnalyzeNamespace groups definitions by normalized name and source precedence, producing deterministic winners, ordered contenders, unavailable sources, and structured collision evidence.
